description: Update the deadline, notes, role or company of an existing application. Inputs: id of the application (from add_application or list_applications), and any of company, role, deadline as YYYY-MM-DD and notes. Only the fields you pass are changed; the rest stay the same. Pass an empty deadline to clear it. Example prompt: "Update application 1 to set the deadline to 2026-11-20 and add a note about the referral."

deadline.description: New deadline as YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string to clear it.

notes.description: New notes, replacing the old ones.

name: update_application

added.description: The day it was added, YYYY-MM-DD.

deadline.description: Last day to apply as YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

interview_date.description: Interview date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or null.

source.description: Where you found the posting, or null.

status.description: The stage the application is in.

updated.description: The day it last changed, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: Update application
